# Hash-pinned dev/test toolchain for the CI lint + unit jobs. Compiled from the
# project's [dev] extra (which also pulls the runtime dep airflow-pytest-operator),

# --no-deps` yields a fully pinned environment. Universal lock: markers cover
# py3.10-3.13 and all platforms.

# Regenerate after changing the [dev] extra in pyproject.toml:
#   uv pip compile pyproject.toml --extra dev --universal --generate-hashes \
#     --python-version 3.10 --no-annotate --no-header -o requirements/dev.txt
